references.text: The same law regarding the bride price (fifty shekels of silver) to the father's house when a man seduces a virgin who is not betrothed.
The preceding verse describes the actual act for which verse 29 gives the consequences.
Contrasting law on divorce - here the man cannot send her away all his days.
Amnon humiliated Tamar (the same Hebrew word 'innah' - to humble/violate) used in this law.
Shechem humiliated Dinah - the same act and concept addressed by the law in Deuteronomy 22:29.
Shechem offers a bride price and gifts for Dinah, in line with the principle of compensation to the father's house.
